pr.title: fix(factory): relax Bindings and Variables for `createMiddleware`

summary: This PR is a pure type-level change to `createMiddleware` in the factory helper — it introduces `AddAnyToEnv` to fill in `any` for whichever of `Bindings`/`Variables` isn't explicitly specified, so nested middlewares with partially-specified `Env` generics no longer cause a TS compile error. There is no runtime behavior change (generic defaults only affect type inference, not emitted JS), and a test was added that exercises the previously-failing pattern. One residual concern is that this intentional type relaxation could also mask genuine Bindings/Variables mismatches in other user code that relied on the previous stricter inference.

findings.rationale: AddAnyToEnv widens the unspecified half of Env to `any`, which relaxes type-safety intentionally to fix the reported false-positive error, but could also mask genuine Bindings/Variables mismatches in other user code that relied on the previous stricter inference (e.g. a middleware declaring only Variables would now get `any` Bindings instead of `{}`/unknown).
findings.suggestedCheck: Confirm existing typed test suites/consumers (e.g. `hono/dist` type tests, `agents-sdk` etc. if present) still catch genuine binding/variable typos after this relaxation; consider adding a type-only negative test (expectTypeOf) proving real mismatches are still caught.
